description: Implementation of SIMD-accelerated element-wise multiplication functions for various data types in the ocuduvec library, including float, complex float, brain float, and int16_t, with functions exposed for use in the ocudu namespace.

methods.name: sc_prod_fff_simd
methods.description: Performs SIMD-accelerated multiplication of float arrays with scalar h, storing result in z.

methods.name: sc_prod_ccc_simd
methods.description: Performs SIMD-accelerated multiplication of complex float arrays with scalar h, storing result in z.

methods.name: sc_prod_ccc_simd (cbf16_t version)
methods.description: Performs SIMD-accelerated multiplication of brain float arrays with scalar h, storing result in z.

methods.name: sc_prod_sss_simd
methods.description: Performs SIMD-accelerated multiplication of int16_t arrays with scalar h, storing result in z.

methods.name: sc_prod_cfc_simd (float h version)
methods.description: Performs SIMD-accelerated multiplication of complex float array with float scalar h, storing result in z.

methods.name: sc_prod_cfc_simd (cbf16_t h version)
methods.description: Performs SIMD-accelerated multiplication of brain float array with float scalar h, storing result in z.
